notes: Aggregates current tax.us.2025.f1099div.box1a-ordinary findings into the box-1a source subtotal under the asserted rounding convention (ADR-0035 decisions 1-2). The source_set names the adopted source-family declaration tax.us.2025.f1099div.1a; an empty family publishes zero only through a current literal-true closure finding admitted by the adopted mapping, and otherwise blocks. This symbol is the box-1a subtotal only - it never publishes to, or stands behind, Form 1040 line 3b directly. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 2): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents, which is the figure the attachment's itemized rows add to, so the attachment ties out when a member carries cents. The line that reads it rounds once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its closure guard is unchanged.
